# SCOOP

> SCOOP turns school emails, WhatsApp threads, newsletters and paper-flyer text into one calm family plan. You paste the message; SCOOP pulls out the events, deadlines, tasks and RSVPs; you review and edit them; they go into a plan you can tick off.

SCOOP is for the parent or carer who is the default keeper of the family calendar. It is phone-first and runs in any modern browser.

## What it does
- Paste any school message: an email, a WhatsApp thread, a newsletter or flyer text.
- Get back four clear types of item: events, deadlines, tasks and RSVPs.
- Review and edit every item — title, date, time, location and notes — before anything is saved.
- See the week in one plan: filter to Today, This Week or All, tick items off, delete what's finished.
- Send anything with a date to Google Calendar, or save it to your phone's calendar.
- Re-paste the same message and duplicate items are skipped.

## What it doesn't do yet
- Forwarding emails straight into SCOOP
- Scanning a paper flyer from a photo
- A WhatsApp integration
- Reminders or notifications
- Sharing one plan between two accounts
